title: pelicans waive taj gibson 41 one day after trade  flm 2026 09 09
text:
Sep 09 (Field Level Media) - The New Orleans Pelicans waived veteran Taj Gibson ​on Wednesday, one day ‌after acquiring the 41-year-old forward/center in a trade.
New Orleans ​added Gibson and ​AJ Johnson from the Memphis ⁠Grizzlies on Tuesday ​in exchange for Jordan ​Hawkins, Micah Peavy, a future second-round draft pick and a ​future second-round pick swap.
Gibson ​averaged 3.4 points and 2.7 ‌rebounds ⁠in 10 games (one start) with Memphis last season.
He has played in 1,012 ​games (462 starts) ​across ⁠17 NBA seasons with eight teams ​since being drafted ​in ⁠the first round (26th overall) by the Chicago Bulls ⁠in ​2009. He has ​career averages of 8.3 points ​and 5.7 rebounds.
--Field Level Media
